const-p-1417-2025-d-b-rahmatullah-anothe.excerpt: SCUG employees, not being civil servants, may invoke Article 199 against a transfer, but that settles only the forum: no one has a vested right to a particular station, and interference lies solely for breach of statutor
const-p-1417-2025-d-b-rahmatullah-anothe.judges: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Arbab Ali Hakro(Author), Hon'ble Mr. Justice Muhammad Osman Ali Hadi
const-p-1417-2025-d-b-rahmatullah-anothe.full_text:
Const. P. 1417/2025 (D.B.) Rahmatullah & Another V/S P.O Sindh & Others
Sindh High Court

Bench: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Arbab Ali Hakro(Author), Hon'ble Mr. Justice Muhammad Osman Ali Hadi

SCUG employees, not being civil servants, may invoke Article 199 against a transfer, but that settles only the forum: no one has a vested right to a particular station, and interference lies solely for breach of statutory tenure or rule, or mala fides on the record. Refusal of the main relief, however, does not bar a direction to the authority to post the employee to a post that lawfully exists.

2026-shc-suk-1894.title: Const. P. 144/2023 (S.B.) Mst. Amna Shaikh V/S Imran Ahmed Shaikh & another
2026-shc-suk-1894.excerpt: A Nikahnama entry showing dower as prompt proves the obligation, not its payment. Section 10(4) of the Act of 1964 allows restoration only of dower actually received, and its relinquishment is itself the Zar-e-Khula. The
2026-shc-suk-1894.judges: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Arbab Ali Hakro(Author)
2026-shc-suk-1894.full_text:
Const. P. 144/2023 (S.B.) Mst. Amna Shaikh V/S Imran Ahmed Shaikh & another
Sindh High Court

Bench: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Arbab Ali Hakro(Author)

A Nikahnama entry showing dower as prompt proves the obligation, not its payment. Section 10(4) of the Act of 1964 allows restoration only of dower actually received, and its relinquishment is itself the Zar-e-Khula. The Qanun-e-Shahadat being excluded by section 17, a wife's consistent account of an ordinary dowry list proves it and cannot be reduced by the Court's own estimate of her family's means.
